# Stocknear

> Free stock, ETF and options research for US markets. Stocknear provides real-time and
> historical market data — financial statements, analyst forecasts, dividends, insider and
> institutional activity, options flow, dark pool orders, congressional trading and market
> screeners — for every listed US stock and ETF. Data is sourced from SEC filings, FINRA,
> exchange feeds and market data vendors.

Ticker paths use the uppercase symbol, e.g. `/stocks/AAPL`, `/etf/SPY`, `/index/^SPX`.
Market data may be delayed; see the data disclaimer for coverage, sources and limitations.

## Core

- [Stocks directory](https://stocknear.com/stocks): browse and search all US listed stocks
- [ETF directory](https://stocknear.com/etf): browse all US listed ETFs
- [Stock screener](https://stocknear.com/stocks/screener): filter stocks on fundamentals and technicals
- [ETF screener](https://stocknear.com/etf/screener): filter ETFs by holdings, expense ratio and performance
- [Learning center](https://stocknear.com/learning-center): tutorials, financial term definitions and daily market briefings
- [Pricing](https://stocknear.com/pricing): subscription plans
- [Data disclaimer](https://stocknear.com/data-disclaimer): data sources, coverage and methodology

## Per-stock analysis

Replace `AAPL` with any US ticker symbol.

- [Overview](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL): quote, key metrics and company summary
- [Financials](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/financials): income statement, plus [balance sheet](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/financials/balance-sheet), [cash flow](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/financials/cash-flow) and [ratios](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/financials/ratios)
- [Statistics](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/statistics): market cap, revenue, short interest and fail-to-deliver history
- [Forecast](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/forecast): price targets, plus [analyst forecasts](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/forecast/analyst)
- [Price history](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/history): historical OHLCV data
- [Dividends](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/dividends): dividend history and yield
- [Profile](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/profile): company profile and employee count history
- [Insider trading](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/insider): plus [institutional holders](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/insider/institute) and [earnings transcripts](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/insider/transcripts)
- [Options](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options): chain, plus [open interest](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/oi), [implied volatility](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/volatility), [max pain](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/max-pain), [gamma exposure](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/gex), [delta exposure](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/dex), [greeks](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/greeks), [expected move](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/expected-move), [unusual activity](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/unusual-activity) and [hottest contracts](https://stocknear.com/stocks/AAPL/options/hottest-contracts)

## Options and order flow

- [Options screener](https://stocknear.com/options-screener): scan contracts across the market
- [Options flow](https://stocknear.com/options-flow): live options order flow
- [Unusual order flow](https://stocknear.com/unusual-order-flow): dark pool and block orders
- [Market flow](https://stocknear.com/market-flow): aggregate market order flow
- [Covered call screener](https://stocknear.com/covered-call-screener) and [cash secured put screener](https://stocknear.com/cash-secured-put-screener)
- [Options calculator](https://stocknear.com/options-calculator): option pricing and payoff
